children: Commercial laundry distributor's fiscal Q4 revenue grew 11% yr/yr to a record high
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q4 rose 26% yr/yr, driven by operational improvements
Company expanded via two acquisitions and launched consumer garment care division
Company expects operating margin expansion as revenue base grows and modernization advances
EVI continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities in commercial laundry and consumer garment care
Company says tariff uncertainty persists but expects to manage through changing market conditions
INSTALLATION TIMING AND INDUSTRIAL SALES - Co said completion of deferred installations and a higher mix of industrial sales contributed to sequential revenue growth in Q4

HIGHER-MARGIN SERVICE AND PARTS - Co attributed margin improvement to growth in service, parts, and consumables revenues, which carry higher margins than equipment sales, and to greater supply chain ownership
OPERATIONAL INVESTMENTS - Co said investments in technology and process standardization improved productivity and helped convert revenue growth into higher earnings
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the industrial machinery & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for EVI Industries Inc is $32.00, about 134.3% above its September 4 closing price of $13.66
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 20 three months ago
